description: Election Commission - Mr. S. Ketin of the Kalutara Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of the member of that Kalutara Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Kalutara Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and member status changes for a local authority, specifically under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or other specialized categories, making it clearly an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
